name: Ricardo Albuquerque
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. A childhood fascination with the vibrant liveries of racing cars evolved into a passion for automotive artistry. After apprenticeships at local body shops, Ricardo honed his skills in color matching, paint application, and custom design. He now brings a wealth of experience to EKS JC. 

Ricardo approaches his work with meticulous precision, viewing each car as a canvas. He thrives on the challenge of translating complex design concepts into flawlessly executed paint schemes. His keen eye for detail and dedication to quality are invaluable assets to the team. Ricardo has an uncanny ability to spot the smallest imperfection, often spending hours perfecting each detail.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always wears a paint-splattered smock, even when not working directly on a car.
Has a collection of miniature racing car models on his workbench, each meticulously painted.
Listens to classic samba music while working, claiming it helps him maintain a steady hand.
